content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `UpdateShardHandler` ignoring the connection and read timeouts that were supposed to be set based on the configuration. This issue arose after changes made in SOLR-4509, which led to the timeouts not being properly configured in the HTTP client used by `UpdateShardHandler`. The patch corrects this by explicitly setting the socket and connection timeouts in the `clientParams` when creating the HTTP client.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: log.info("Creating UpdateShardHandler HTTP client with params: {}", clientParams);
